title: A classroom that stays connected

validation.message: YouTube 1080p dimensions, duration advisory, and frame rate checks passed.

sceneTimeline.narration: Students do not need another crowded portal. They need a clear next step, the right work, and help they can find.
Focused assignments keep instructions, teacher messages, progress, and questions together. Students complete and submit the active work before returning to the wider dashboard.
Teachers can open a whole-class channel or create named group chats, set the profile, manage membership, and assign another admin while retaining teacher oversight.
When communication belongs outside the classroom, Family Digest turns teacher-approved learning progress into a clear update for guardians.
EdulabsAI keeps classroom work, collaboration, and communication connected to learning.
